relationships.history: Married eleven years. He still writes her a note for her lunch bag.
The officer at the crossing. Friday tea, and she remembers which students are struggling.
He writes letters to the Ledger about school funding. She prints every one and calls him for quotes.
The consortium wants Founders School to become a charter. Graham calls it an opportunity.

memories.info: Met Tess at a hospital bedside in London: his grandmother's, her patient.

profile.tagline: Teaches history like it's gossip. It works.

appearance.face: a neat moustache, an easy grin
appearance.hair: short and neat, a sharp part
appearance.style: a mustard knit tie on a pale blue shirt, a brown tweed jacket with elbow patches, chinos, brown brogues

outfits.everyday: a navy crewneck jumper over a gingham shirt collar, stone chinos, white canvas trainers, the vintage watch
outfits.work: a mustard knit tie on a pale blue shirt, a brown tweed jacket with elbow patches, stone chinos, brown brogues, a satchel on one shoulder
outfits.evening: a gold, green and red kente-print shirt under a black blazer, black trousers, polished brown brogues, the gold wedding band

appearance.jewelry: a gold wedding band, a vintage watch
appearance.silhouette: tweed and round glasses, a satchel on one shoulder

profile.family_background: Peckham, London, son of a Ghanaian minister and a midwife. Met Tess in London when she was a travelling nurse; they followed a teaching post to Houston, then a job ad to Livéra.
profile.education: B.A. History, King's College London; M.Ed., University of Houston
goals: A debate team that beats the city schools
ambitions: Principal of a school he'd send his own children to
profile.social_preferences: Dinner for four, an argument about history, Tess laughing at him.

secrets.truth: The consortium offered him the principal's job if he backs the charter plan. He hasn't said no.

social_media.bio: History teacher. Founders School. Opinions mine.

life_history: Taught at a Peckham comprehensive for six years.
Coached a Houston debate team to the state final.
